title: n_k on-device discriminating falsifier: record of the sealed device attempt (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-05)

summary.statement: The sealed job was launched twice on 2026-09-03 against live ibm_fez. Launch 1 (14:27:21Z) stopped in the chain-selection step on an uncalibrated T2 (qubit 72); launch 2 (14:28:29Z) applied the sealed day-of chain rule and forfeited the window. Neither reached the submission code. On 2026-09-04 a window opened on ibm_kingston only under a proposed amended rule (looser T1/T2 floors plus a readout cap) that required a manifest v2; it could not fire. On 2026-09-05 gate v4 denied the amendment, so manifest v1 stands, and no backend offered a v1-compliant chain. No device job was created after the seal.
summary.requery_verdict: every re-queried snapshot (ibm_fez 2026-09-03 at both launches; ibm_fez, ibm_marrakesh, ibm_kingston 2026-09-05; ibm_kingston 2026-09-04 window) forfeits under the sealed v1 rule

manifest_v1.day_of_chain_rule_verbatim: accept the chain iff min over chain qubits of day-of calibrated T1_q >= 150 us AND T2_q >= 100 us AND no chain CZ error > 2x device median; otherwise re-select the chain or forfeit the window
manifest_v1.kill_rule_verbatim: day-of chain rule fails -> forfeit window
manifest_v1.implementation_note: the rule is applied as: every chain qubit has calibrated T1 >= 150 us and T2 >= 100 us (a qubit without a calibrated T1 or T2 fails); every one of the 11 chain edges has CZ error <= 2 x the median CZ error over the coupled pairs of the same snapshot; the chain is a simple path in the coupling map

entries.label: Watcher v3 patched to require manifest v2 before signalling, and relaunched
entries.text:
cd "C:/Users/Nicolas/Downloads/Proyecto_SQD_ML/Quantum_for_AI/A_payload_echoes/03_src" && py - << 'PYEOF'
p = 'green_light_watch_v3.py'
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
# gate the GREEN exit on manifest v2 existing; otherwise just log the window
s = s.replace(
    "            if c30 and rem >= 130:\n"
    "                print(f\"GREEN(ro030): {bn} chain={c30} rem={rem}s\", flush=True)\n"
    "                found_any = True",
    "            if c30 and rem >= 130:\n"
    "                sealed = os.path.exists(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '06_results',\n"
    "                                                     'manifest_nk_device_v2.json'))\n"
    "                if sealed:\n"
    "                    print(f\"GREEN(ro030): {bn} chain={c30} rem={rem}s\", flush=True)\n"
    "                    found_any = True\n"
    "                else:\n"
    "                    print(f\"  [green window OPEN on {bn} but manifest v2 not sealed -> \"\n"
    "                          f\"cannot fire; chain={c30}]\", flush=True)"
)
# also re-check every pulse (not only on new calibration) once sealed appears
s = s.replace(
    "            if cal == last.get(bn): continue",
    "            sealed_now = os.path.exists(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '06_results',\n"
    "                                                     'manifest_nk_device_v2.json'))\n"
    "            if cal == last.get(bn) and not sealed_now: continue"
)
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('watcher v3 patched: green exit now requires manifest v2')
PYEOF
cd "C:/Users/Nicolas/Downloads/Proyecto_SQD_ML/Quantum_for_AI/A_payload_echoes/03_src" && "C:/tmp/ibmqpu/Scripts/python.exe" -u green_light_watch_v3.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -vE "stevedore|Deprecation"
